rules.name: MOUNTAIN HOME
rules.text: Your [Presence] may only be added/moved into Mountains.
rules.turn:
add-presence S, spirit:special S mountain-home, (presence-choice S C)
  !(land:terrain C mountain)
rules.evidence: Growth add-presence moved v4 to l3 (the only mountain) on every run.
rules.notes: Same narrowing pattern as Ocean's inland ban. Only 'added' is covered: core has no generic 'move Presence' choice to constrain, so 'moved' would need every Presence-moving effect to go through a named choice.

rules.name: COLLAPSE IN A BLAST OF LAVA AND STEAM
rules.text: When your [Presence] is destroyed, in that land, deal 1 Damage per destroyed [Presence] to both Invaders and to [Dahan] .
rules.turn:
destroy-presence C, is C X, presence-of S X, spirit:special S collapse, at X L
  ~damage-invaders L 1
  ~damage-dahan-in L 1
rules.evidence: Each Blight-destroyed Volcano Presence in l3 produced damage-invaders l3 1 and damage-dahan-in l3 1; the Explorer (1 Health) was destroyed, the Dahan (2 Health) after the second collapse.
rules.notes: Needed a whole Damage/Health BASE-EXT (turn-scoped dmg tuples, destroy when damage >= health, rng distribution of N damage). 'per destroyed Presence' is satisfied by firing once per destroy-presence episode; simultaneous destructions are not merged.

rules.name: VOLCANIC PEAKS TOWER OVER THE LANDSCAPE
rules.text: Your Power Cards gain +1 [Range] if you have 3 or more [Presence] in the origin land.
rules.turn:
played S P, power-card P, spirit:special S peaks, presence-count S O N, ge N 3
  / power-range S P O 1
rules.evidence: range-0 card: can-target l3 only without the rule; can-target l3 and l2 with it (3 Presence in l3).
rules.notes: Clean once Range is a per-origin @sum (power-range S P O R): the bonus is one more contribution keyed by the origin land, so 'in the origin land' is exactly the key. Range itself (reach with bounded recursion) is BASE-EXT.

base_ext: Damage/Health (persistent dmg facts on deal-damage-to's chain + destroy check (a `turn, >damage-mark, ^dmg` view now starts concurrently with the check; core has one turn, so the turn scope is not needed), player-divided N damage to Invaders or Dahan), Range/targeting (reach acc with bounded recursion, power-range @sum per origin, targetable). The played card is a turn-scoped acc view (`#acc played`).
language_issues: Run hits gas from core's unbounded Blight cascades once l2 and l3 are both blighted (the collapse test adds Blight to l3); results above are from before gas.
Damage that lasts 'until end of turn' needs the `turn, >damage-mark P N, ^dmg P N` idiom because damage is dealt deep inside nested episodes; there is no way to name the turn directly.
